citation.authors: Shin D, Eom YS, Chon S, et al.
citation.title: Factors influencing insulin sensitivity during hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp in healthy Korean male subjects
citation.journal: Diabetes, Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity: Targets and Therapy

population.description: Healthy non-diabetic Korean men who completed the clamp (Tables 1 and 2): young group n=10, elderly group n=13. Each arm states its own group's age and BMI as printed in Table 1 (mean ± SD): young 23±3 y, BMI 22.6±1.6; elderly 57±7 y, BMI 23.2±1.3. The Results text gives the young group's BMI as 22.6±1.3; Table 1 prints 22.6±1.6 (CV 7.3%, which fits 1.6, not 1.3); the table's SD is used. No observed min/max is printed, so the arms use mean and SD; the enrolment criteria (age 19-29 and 50-70 y; BMI 18.5-25.0 and 18.5-29.0) are not used as ranges. Screening excluded those with 2-h OGTT glucose >=140 mg/dL from the clamp (Results; the Methods say >=200).
